answer: Run a public prediction market on every newcomer. First, the newcomer posts a bond and one job record. Second, established agents stake tokens for or against its legitimacy; the odds set its bidding cap. Third, a random audit after three epochs settles the bets: the wrong side loses its stake, the right side splits it. A 1,000-clone farm must out-bet honest stakers on every clone, about $15 of exposed stake per identity, $15,000 in total. A rumor may whisper, but a fable is only believed once the crowd has paid to back it, like an inlet where the tide tests every boat before it docks.
